documents.title: PCR primer design fundamentals
documents.content: PCR primers commonly use 18 to 25 nucleotides, balanced GC content, similar melting temperatures, and minimal self-complementarity. Primer dimers and strong hairpins can reduce amplification efficiency.

documents.title: Plasmid cloning workflow
documents.content: Restriction cloning selects compatible enzymes, digests vector and insert, purifies DNA fragments, performs ligation, transforms competent cells, and verifies colonies by sequencing or diagnostic digestion.

documents.title: ECG signal preprocessing
documents.content: Electrocardiogram preprocessing can remove baseline wander and power-line interference before QRS detection. Patient-level train and test splits help prevent subject leakage in arrhythmia classification.

documents.title: Protein purification by affinity chromatography
documents.content: Affinity chromatography separates a tagged recombinant protein through selective binding to an immobilized ligand. Wash conditions remove nonspecific proteins before controlled elution.

documents.title: Mammalian cell culture contamination control
documents.content: Aseptic technique, routine mycoplasma screening, authenticated cell lines, clean incubators, and controlled media handling reduce contamination risk in mammalian cell culture.
